_what_it_tests: A single 'info' fault — the severity level your catalog currently cannot produce.
_expect: One emissions icon, styled .fault-banner.info (blue, style.css:24). This is the first time that CSS rule will ever have rendered.
_why_this_code: P0442 is a small EVAP leak and is famously caused by a loose fuel cap. It is the canonical example of a code that lights the check-engine lamp and is genuinely not urgent — which is exactly what 'deferrable' in describe() is for. DECISIONS.md already references 'the P0442 case'.
